Photo 1 shows the same dryer from a side angle, revealing a purple interior light and a label with 'CONAIR' and 'Pro Style 1578' printed on it. The base has a purple glow.

The brand 'CONAIR' is clearly visible on the front of the unit in photo 0 and on the side in photo 1.
